_doc: Minimal schema for config/coach_settings.json. Read by coach_integration.py and the coach engines at runtime.

_notes.model: Must be a valid Anthropic model string. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 is the default for low-latency live coaching.
_notes.tft_pbe: RETIRED (RM-292 b, 2026-10-25): read by nothing. It used to route TFT to a PBE coach through a loader that had no caller; both were deleted. Still TOLERATED as a legacy key so an existing config keeps validating; new configs should omit it.
